figurative_meaning_en: bizarre; grotesque; unnatural or out of creation
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই অদ্ভুত নকশাটি দেখে মনে হলো একেবারে অনাসৃষ্টি।
শহরের এই অগোছালো অংশটি অনাসৃষ্টির মতো লাগছে।
example_sentences_in_english: This bizarre design feels like a complete monstrosity.
This disorganized part of the city looks like a freak of nature.
history: Used by Rabindranath Tagore in a literary context to describe unnatural calamities like famine and drought.
note: Primarily literary usage, evoking a sense of unnatural horror or ugliness.
